regions.region: page top, continuation from the left column of page 6
regions.finding: The paragraph for product 3s continues with its 93:8 e.r., chiral-HPLC conditions/major-minor retention times, and HRMS. The e.r. method was merged into the existing 3s scope experiment; this continuation is not a new synthesis.

Preparation/characterization paragraphs for 3t, 3u, and 5a-5f report product names, masses, repeated yields, optical rotations, NMR, product-specific e.r./chiral-HPLC methods, and HRMS. Mass and e.r. results were associated with the existing Scheme 2/3 experiments; spectra and HRMS remain characterization context. No reaction arrow or table row on this page creates an additional experiment.

regions.region: bottom of right column, Associated Content notice
regions.finding: The page advertises a Supporting Information PDF containing spectra. No SI file was explicitly supplied or associated in source_mapping.json, so the notice was retained as context and no SI evidence was inferred.
